From the manufacturer

Quality Without Complexity

The EOS Rebel T7 camera can help mobile device users take their photography to the next level. With a large 24.1 Megapixel CMOS sensor, fast autofocus, built-in wireless connectivity and more, it combines fantastic features with easy operation for high-quality images you'll be proud to share.

  1. 24.1 MP CMOS Sensor

    High-pixel, High-quality

    The large, high-resolution 24.1 Megapixel CMOS sensor helps capture rich details and vibrant colors.

  2. DIGIC 4+ Image Processor

    Impressive Performance

    The DIGIC 4+ Image Processor creates fast performance and reduces image noise, even in low light.

    Connect. Upload. Share.

Previous page

  1. Beautiful Full HD Videos Made Easy

    Capture breathtaking Full HD quality video in a variety of recording sizes and frame rates, including 30p for a natural look. The camera's wide ISO range means confident shooting in nearly any light.

  2. Capture the Moment as You See It

    The EOS Rebel T7 camera's Optical Viewfinder lets you quickly line up and capture a photo in virtually any situation. It also helps you accurately see what the lens sees, even in bright sunlight.

  3. The Power of EOS Autofocus

    The EOS Rebel T7 camera features fast and accurate autofocus, which can enhance your shooting experience by making sure you're ready to capture the action as soon as it happens.

  4. Compose the Image You Want

    Scene Intelligent Auto mode delivers accurate exposure and enhancements to help bring out the beauty in virtually any scene, so you can concentrate on composing images without puzzling over settings.

  5. Explore Your Creativity with EF Lenses

    The EOS Rebel T7 camera's compatibility with all Canon EF and EF-S lenses provides plenty of creative opportunities for capturing everything from grand landscapes to faraway wildlife and more.

Product Description

Perfect for beginners, this camera bundle offers the essential tools needed to take your SLR skills to new heights, all in one convenient package. No matter where your next adventure takes you, count on the EOS Rebel t7's impressive 24.1 Megapixel CMOS sensor and wide ISO range of 100-6400 (H: 12800) to capture high-quality images, even in low-light situations.

    Amazon Customer
    5 out of 5 stars
    A Must Buy For Those Who Love Nature Photos!
    I received this camera today and am very excited to use it, so this might be a rushed review! LOVE the camera! It has great beginner friendly modes and is very simple to use and get the feel of. I will say that if you have never used any form of ‘professional’ camera, the different modes and buttons may confuse you for a bit, but once you get adjusted it’s very simple! The lens is nice and allows ample zoom to allow close ups! However, if you are looking for zoom quality from ample distance, you’re going to need another lens. I ordered a telephoto lens, so I’ll see how that works out. In terms of pricing, the camera is amazing quality, though I did end up finding bundle kits that come with a bit more for the same price. If you’re looking for quality pieces only, then this is definitely the right pick! The camera is fairly lightweight in itself, with lenses it will obviously get heavier, but not bulky and very easy to handle with the grip. All the different modes and settings allow for a variety of pictures! I’m more focused on nature pictures, but this does great for people and animals. The camera has GREAT picture quality and refined details. I’m able to magnify into my photos and see crystal clear details you can’t see with the naked eye. I do hiking occasionally, so this camera is going to be great for it! Very excited to see how it does as we plan on going to upstate NY for a hiking expedition and visiting multiple spots. I’ll update further on its performance if needed!

      However, if you are looking for zoom quality from ample distance, you’re going to need another lens. I ordered a telephoto lens, so I’ll see how that works out.

      In terms of pricing, the camera is amazing quality, though I did end up finding bundle kits that come with a bit more for the same price. If you’re looking for quality pieces only, then this is definitely the right pick!

      The camera is fairly lightweight in itself, with lenses it will obviously get heavier, but not bulky and very easy to handle with the grip.

      All the different modes and settings allow for a variety of pictures! I’m more focused on nature pictures, but this does great for people and animals.

      The camera has GREAT picture quality and refined details. I’m able to magnify into my photos and see crystal clear details you can’t see with the naked eye.

      I do hiking occasionally, so this camera is going to be great for it! Very excited to see how it does as we plan on going to upstate NY for a hiking expedition and visiting multiple spots.

      I’ll update further on its performance if needed!

      5 out of 5 stars
      Beginner-Friendly, Pro-Ready — The Perfect Launchpad into DSLR Photography
      Reviewed in the United States on June 18, 2025
      Style: Body w/ 18-55mm Lens
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      As someone who wanted to level up from phone photography but wasn’t quite ready to dive into $2,000 camera bodies, the Canon EOS Rebel T7 was the perfect bridge — and it has exceeded expectations.

      ⸻

      Image Quality

      The 24.1 MP sensor captures crisp, clean images in both daylight and low light. You’ll instantly notice the difference in depth, clarity, and color accuracy compared to any smartphone. Whether you’re shooting portraits, street scenes, or nature — it delivers professional-looking results.

      ⸻

      Ease of Use

      This is where the T7 shines. The controls are intuitive, even for someone brand new to DSLRs. The built-in Feature Guide explains settings in real-time, helping you learn as you shoot. It’s like a camera and teacher in one.

      ⸻

      Connectivity

      Built-in Wi-Fi is a huge plus. I can snap a photo and send it to my phone instantly for social media or editing. The Canon Camera Connect app works smoothly with iOS and Android.

      ⸻

      Build & Features

      • Lightweight but solid — feels durable without being bulky

      • Interchangeable lenses give you room to grow (the included 18–55mm lens is a great start)

      • 3 FPS continuous shooting — not blazing fast, but great for beginners shooting action

      • Full HD 1080p video recording — smooth, with decent autofocus

      ⸻

      Who It’s For

      If you’re a beginner who wants a real DSLR experience without feeling overwhelmed — this is your camera. It’s also a great backup for experienced shooters who want something reliable, portable, and affordable.

      ⸻

      Final Verdict

      The Canon EOS Rebel T7 is proof that entry-level doesn’t mean low quality. It’s a fantastic intro into the world of serious photography, and once you start using it, you’ll wonder why you waited. Sharp photos, simple learning curve, and real Canon reliability.

      Worth buying
      Reviewed in Canada on February 2, 2024
      Style: Body w/ 18-55mm Lens
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      The Canon Rebel T7 camera offers a compelling entry-level experience for photography enthusiasts. Its 24.1-megapixel APS-C CMOS sensor delivers crisp and vibrant images, while the DIGIC 4+ image processor ensures swift performance.

      The camera's autofocus system performs admirably, especially in well-lit conditions, providing quick and accurate focus on subjects. Its beginner-friendly features, such as Scene Intelligent Auto mode, make it accessible for those new to DSLR photography.

      The T7's ergonomic design and lightweight build enhance portability without compromising on durability. The 3-inch LCD screen is clear and bright, facilitating easy composition and review of shots.

      While the camera lacks advanced features like 4K video recording, its Full HD video capabilities produce decent results. Battery life is commendable, allowing for extended shooting sessions without constant recharging.

      In conclusion, the Canon Rebel T7 is an excellent choice for entry-level photographers seeking a reliable and user-friendly DSLR camera with solid image quality and performance.
